title: 第3章 超能力解锁
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

夜深人静。

房门被轻轻地带上，心事重重的母亲贝卡悄声离开卧房。

莱恩躺在床上，闭着眼，呼吸平缓，一副已经熟睡了的乖巧模样。

【日常扮演经验+13（当日结算/数量不定）】

【情绪演技爆发，经验+2000】

莱恩的意识沉静，先扫了眼白天与祖国人父子相认时增加的经验值数额。

很满意。

不愧是阿祖，爆出来的经验值果然多。

不像以往，每次沃特公司监控人员来时他费劲心力地扮演，爆出来的经验最多也就是个三位数。

另外……

莱恩想着，那个曾经给过贝卡一巴掌的乔尼，现在应该被祖国人给扬了吧。

关于乔尼的事只是一闪而过，随后他心念一动，视线便落在了金手指化作的技能面板上。

一列列已解锁和未开启的技能出现。

【热视线·一级】（自然觉醒）

升级经验值：1／5000

一级效果：可控低温灼烧//最小威力鲜奶加热——最大可穿透十公分厚墙壁，对碳基生物具备有效杀伤

【钢铁之躯·二级】

升级经验值：172/10000

一级效果：皮肤、肌肉钢铁拟态化，可抵御穿甲弹射击，但会造成内部冲击、震荡损伤

二级效果：皮肤、肌肉、骨骼进阶为高强度合金拟态化，无惧常规热武器伤害，有效抵御冲击、震荡损伤

【超级视力·一级】

升级经验值：1／3000

一级效果：极限远视，百米内清晰视物，浅层透视（衣物、薄木板、薄墙壁等），金属、厚混凝体等物无效。唯独锌元素可完全阻隔视野！！！

【超级听力·一级】

升级经验值：1／3000

一级效果：听力远超普通人，百米内低语清晰可辨，可分辨细微环境声，自动锁定声源方位

【可解锁开启能力：超级嗅觉、超级力量、超级耐力、自愈、飞行、弱等生物力场】

【总经验：21213】

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's quiet at night.

The door was gently closed, and the worried mother Beka quietly left the bedroom.

Ryan was lying on the bed, his eyes closed, his breathing slow, and he looked like he was already asleep.

[Daily playing experience +13 (settled on the day/amount is variable)]

[Emotional acting skills explode, experience +2000]

Ryan's consciousness was calm, and he first glanced at the amount of experience points gained when he met the father and son of the motherland during the day.

Very satisfied.

As expected of Azu, he really gained a lot of experience points.

Unlike in the past, every time the surveillance personnel from Watt Company came, he worked hard to perform, and the experience he revealed was only three digits at most.

Also…

Ryan thought that Johnny, who once slapped Beka, should now be praised by the people of his motherland.

The thing about Johnny just flashed by, and then his mind moved, and his eyes fell on the skill panel transformed by Goldfinger.

A list of unlocked and unactivated skills appears.

[Thermal Vision·Level 1] (Natural Awakening)

Upgrade experience value: 1/5000

First-level effect: controllable low-temperature burning // Minimum power for heating fresh milk - can penetrate walls up to ten centimeters thick, effective against carbon-based organisms

[Man of Steel·Level 2]

Upgrade experience value: 172/10000

First-level effect: Skin and muscles are transformed into steel, which can resist armor-piercing bullets, but will cause internal impact and concussion damage.

Secondary effect: skin, muscles, and bones are upgraded to high-strength alloy mimics, without fear of damage from conventional thermal weapons, and effectively resist impact and concussion damage

[Super Vision·Level 1]

Upgrade experience value: 1/3000

First-level effect: Extreme farsightedness, clear vision within 100 meters, shallow perspective (clothing, thin boards, thin walls, etc.), invalid for metal, thick concrete, etc.Only zinc can completely block the view!!!

【Super Hearing·Level 1】

Upgrade experience value: 1/3000

Level 1 effect: Hearing far exceeds that of ordinary people, whispers can be clearly discerned within 100 meters, subtle environmental sounds can be distinguished, and the direction of the sound source is automatically locked.

[Abilities that can be unlocked: super sense of smell, super strength, super endurance, self-healing, flying, weak biological force fields, etc.]

[Total experience: 21213]
